title: The Missing Truffle Box
scene: At 4:10 PM, the golden truffle box vanished from the pantry. Only the chef saw the green satin bow left snagged on the shelf.

suspects.name: Agnes Doyle
suspects.testimony: I tempered dark chocolate at the front counter from 3:50 to 4:10 PM before checking the pantry.
suspects.alibiProof: Three window shoppers watched Agnes tempering chocolate at the front counter until 4:10 PM.

suspects.name: Emil Brandt
suspects.testimony: I stacked cocoa tins right outside the pantry door from 3:55 to 4:15 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: The delivery clerk stepped past Emil stacking cocoa tins by the pantry from 3:55 to 4:15 PM.

suspects.name: Vera Stone
suspects.testimony: I sipped espresso at a corner table from 3:50 to 4:15 PM—I never touched any box with a green satin bow!
suspects.contradiction: Nobody had mentioned the green satin bow, and gold foil flakes were stuck to Vera's notebook.

suspects.name: Dante Silva
suspects.testimony: I counted receipts at the register from 3:50 to 4:15 PM and never walked to the back.
suspects.alibiProof: The register camera shows Dante counting receipts continuously from 3:50 to 4:15 PM.
